welcome.title: Welcome back.
welcome.bodyAfter: . Rebuilt from the ground up, with everything you made coming along.

migrate.title: Moving your data
migrate.body: Your chats, characters and media are coming over.
migrate.note: Keep the app open until it finishes.

models.checking: Checking which features your chats use
models.bodyPending_memory: Some of your chats use dynamic memory. Its model downloads once, then runs offline.
models.bodyPending_emotion: Some of your chats use companion emotions. Its model downloads once, then runs offline.
models.bodyPending_both: Some of your chats use dynamic memory and companion emotions. Their models download once, then run offline.
models.bodyReady_memory: Dynamic memory is ready and runs offline.
models.bodyReady_emotion: Companion emotions are ready and run offline.
models.bodyReady_both: Dynamic memory and companion emotions are ready and run offline.
models.notNowNote: Chats that need these models will ask for them. You can download them later in Settings.
models.keepOpen: Keep the app open until it finishes.

done.title: You're all set.
done.body: Everything is where you left it.

redesign.title: We redesigned everything.
redesign.body: Every screen, rebuilt from scratch. Here is what is new in 3.0.

groups.title: Groups can do it all now.
groups.body: Scene images, memory, lorebooks and a model per member. Everything one-on-one chats have.

companionGroups.title: Companion group chats.
companionGroups.body: Put your companions in one chat. Each keeps their own memories, feelings and bond with you, and with each other.

creator.title: Make a character by talking.
creator.body: Describe who you want, get a portrait, and approve every change before it is saved.

models.title: Our own models.
models.body: Eidos picks what to remember and skips repeats. Thymos reads how a companion feels. Both run on your device.

lorebooks.title: Lorebooks that understand sentences.
lorebooks.body: Ask for a second keyword, match phrases like (went|go) to the * bar, and test regex as you type.

changes.title: Everything in 3.0
changes.emptyBody: Try another word, or show all changes.

upgrade.title: One step first
upgrade.body: Your data is from an older LettuceAI. Open it once with version {{version}} so it can be updated, then come back here.
